name: Qwen3 32B
summary: Alibaba's dense 32B Qwen3 — hybrid thinking modes, strong tool use and multilingual coverage.

name: DeepSeek R1 Distill 32B
summary: R1 reasoning distilled onto a Qwen 32B base — long deliberate chains of thought on local iron.

name: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct
summary: Meta's 70B instruct — needs real iron; an A6000-class card handles Q4, consumer 24GB does not.

name: Gemma 3 27B
summary: Google's largest Gemma 3 — multimodal, 128k context, strong for its weight class.

name: Mistral Small 3.2 24B
summary: Mistral's 24B workhorse — fast, tool-capable, comfortable on a single 24GB card at Q4.

name: Qwen2.5 Coder 32B
summary: The strongest open coder in its class for a long stretch — still the local default for many.

name: Phi-4 14B
summary: Microsoft's dense 14B — outsized reasoning for its parameter count, light enough for 12GB cards.

name: Llama 3.2 3B
summary: Small enough for laptops and edge boxes; a sane default when VRAM is single-digit.

name: QwQ 32B
summary: Qwen's reasoning-specialized 32B — long deliberate chains, competitive with much larger models on math and code.

name: Mixtral 8x7B
summary: Mistral's sparse mixture-of-experts — 8x7B, fast inference for its quality because only two experts fire per token.

name: Code Llama 13B
summary: Meta's Code Llama 13B — a long-standing local coding staple, comfortable on a 12-16GB card at Q4.

name: LLaVA 13B
summary: The classic open vision-language model — image understanding plus chat, GGUF-packaged for local use.

name: Nomic Embed Text
summary: A strong open text-embedding model — tiny, fast, the default local choice for RAG and search.

name: StarCoder2 15B
summary: BigCode's 15B trained on The Stack v2 — broad language coverage, a solid mid-size local coder.

name: Granite 3.1 Dense 8B
summary: IBM's Apache-2.0 Granite 3.1 — enterprise-minded, strong tool use, 128k context at 8B.
